web.readFailed: The current server data could not be loaded. Empty or old displays do not confirm the server state. Your form is preserved; check the connection/server configuration.
web.pendingWrite: A server write has not been fully settled. Further writes are blocked. It is not retried automatically; the exact IDs and content remain stored locally.
web.journalInvalid: The write journal cannot be read. Do not delete it or issue new writes.
web.retryFailed: Still unsettled. Server switches/restores need separate review. The journal is retained.
web.versionConflict: This record has changed or been deleted. Your form is preserved. Load and consciously compare the current server state; nothing was overwritten.
web.dependencyConflict: This record is still referenced or dependencies have changed. Review these first; no automatic web deletion cascade.
web.unconfirmedUpload: Please settle the saved server request shown above first.
web.deletionPreviewRequired: Review and explicitly confirm the version-bound deletion preview above.
web.historyConflict: This deletion would affect booked entries or their historical calculations and is blocked.

review.noOverwrite: Your form remains unchanged. There is no automatic overwrite or rebase. Compare the values; after consciously reloading you can enter your desired changes again.
review.baseUnknown: Original base unavailable (new record, legacy journal or bounded read cache). The current server state is not presented as the original base.
review.rawDraft: Original form fields, not yet mapped to server fields.
review.serverUnavailable: Server state could not be loaded; this does not mean that the record is absent.
review.export: Save comparison and draft as JSON
review.reloadWarning: I want to reload. All unsaved form inputs on this page will be lost; I have saved any drafts I need first.
review.deleteRule: Only the displayed versions are confirmed. Direct ingredient references may be removed; indirect recipes are not deleted. This cascade must not change booked entries or their calculations.
review.historyBlocked: Deletion blocked: existing meal/activity bookings or their calculations would be affected. Nothing is deleted, archived or recalculated.
review.confirmDelete: I confirm deletion and the displayed reference changes at these exact versions.
review.deleted: Deletion confirmed. Lists were refreshed; other form drafts remain unchanged.
review.failed: Deletion was not fully settled. Check the conflict display or write journal; do not blindly retry against new versions.

syncAutomatic.title: Automatic synchronization
syncAutomatic.scope: Optionally send and receive on startup or return to the app. Off by default. Runs in the dashboard, pauses on other pages and during navigation; no background loop or automatic conflict decisions.
syncAutomatic.setup: Connect a server, complete initial reconciliation and explicitly trust its address first.
syncAutomatic.resume: Synchronize when returning to the app
syncAutomatic.failed: Last automatic sync did not finish ({code}). Durable progress is preserved; check settings.

syncManual.title: Manual synchronization
syncManual.scope: This button sends queued phone changes and applies new server data. Automatic startup and resume sync can be enabled separately; no background loop.
syncManual.setup: Once: check connection → stage server snapshot → review initial reconciliation → confirm Keep both. Then Sync now becomes available.
syncManual.uncertain: An earlier upload reply is missing. Only the exact saved request is replayed; local drafts are preserved.
syncManual.result: {uploaded} upload groups confirmed · {received} received groups processed · {pending} changes remaining · {blocked} groups blocked

errors.conflictsPending: Conflicts remain. Review current conflicts below and explicitly decide; nothing is silently overwritten.
errors.unconfirmedUpload: An upload remains unconfirmed. Do not disconnect or restore; settle the saved upload first.
errors.writeJournalInvalid: The local upload journal is incomplete or changed. No new request sent; please request diagnostics.
errors.moreWork: More received data remains. Durable progress is preserved; synchronize again.
errors.versionConflict: The server version changed meanwhile. No automatic overwrite; review conflicts.
errors.dependencyConflict: A server dependency changed. No unconfirmed cascade deletion; review conflicts.

syncPreparation.title: Connect and synchronize with server
syncPreparation.scope: Connection checks and downloads do not change business data. Initial reconciliation and conflict decisions require separate confirmation. Manual sync is then available; automation requires an additional explicit opt-in.
syncPreparation.security: There is no authentication yet. Only connect to a server on your secure private network. Nutrition data is transferred to the selected address.
syncPreparation.secure: I trust this address and its network access controls.
syncPreparation.validated: Complete dataset validated. Local business data is unchanged; automatic synchronization remains off.
syncPreparation.failed: Preparation failed ({code}). No automatic retry or binding switch.

syncDecision.title: Initial reconciliation and conflict decisions
syncDecision.scope: Decisions affect this device only. Local winners become new version-bound operations, not uploads yet. Matching names do not mean matching records.
syncDecision.inventory: {local} local and {server} active server aggregates (profiles, foods, recipes, meals).

modes.combine: Keep both: preserve local data and add server data; resolve conflicts separately.
modes.local: Start with local data (empty server only).
modes.server: Server data only: replace the local dataset.

syncDecision.replaceWarning: All previous local business data and pending changes will be replaced. The shared server is not changed.
syncDecision.backupHint: A separate unencrypted safety backup is saved before applying. Nothing changes if saving fails.
syncDecision.confirm: I confirm the selected reconciliation or all decisions.
syncDecision.confirmDeletion: I also confirm deletions or resurrection of deleted records.
syncDecision.groups: {groups} retained groups, {roots} related records. Companions in pending local transactions also need a decision.
syncDecision.keepLocal: Keep local state and queue a new operation
syncDecision.keepServer: Accept server state; discard pending local change
syncDecision.fullFields: Show all fields and UUID references
syncDecision.dependencies: Incompatible references, duplicate EANs and recipe cycles are not resolved automatically. Edit affected data first or choose a consistent combination; no dependency is deleted without consent.
syncDecision.exportRecovery: Export backup from before latest sync decision
syncDecision.connected: Initial reconciliation applied. Sync now sends your phone changes and receives server data. Nothing uploaded yet.
syncDecision.connectedBlocked: Connection recorded. Conflicting groups remain fully retained; review them separately. No automatic upload.
syncDecision.resolved: Decisions saved. Local winners wait in new operations. Sync now sends them; nothing uploaded yet.

errors.previewChanged: Local or server data changed since the preview. Please review and decide again.
errors.unconfirmedUpload: An unconfirmed upload may already have committed on the server. Its outcome must be settled before its contents can be discarded.
errors.eanConflict: The selected states contain a duplicate EAN. Edit it first; records will not be silently merged.
errors.localDependency: Accepting this would delete local dependencies. Edit them first or keep a consistent local state.
errors.serverDependency: The local winners are incompatible with current server references. Additional dependent changes are needed.
errors.identityConflict: A UUID belongs to a different owner. No automatic remapping is possible.
errors.recipeCycle: This combination would create a recipe cycle.

syncDisconnect.warning: {roots} active aggregates keep all UUIDs, numeric IDs and references on this device. The old binding, cursor and technical conflicts are removed. Unsent operations are replaced by the latest local state. Another server or a restored server requires fresh initial reconciliation. No network request or server deletion.
syncDisconnect.confirm: I confirm local detachment and fresh initial reconciliation before reconnecting.
syncDisconnect.applied: Disconnected; business data preserved. Sync remains off. Confirm the address and reconcile again before reconnecting.

foodAlias.none: No safe local EAN mappings. Server-registered foods or locally edited targets need ordinary version decisions.
foodAlias.references: {ingredients} ingredients and {meals} direct meals will be remapped. {companions} related local aggregates will be queued again, preserving their original base revisions.
foodAlias.warning: The local food is replaced by the server identity. Its nutrition values will also affect existing recipes and historical meals. Amounts, portion factors and logged times remain unchanged. No server deletion or upload. Other retained groups still need ordinary decisions.
foodAlias.confirm: I confirm this identity/reference mapping, nutrition change and replacement of related unsent operations.
foodAlias.applied: Mapping saved and references updated. Nothing uploaded; sync remains off. Review remaining conflict groups again.

backup.title: Local backup
backup.hint: Export all profiles, foods, recipes, ingredients, meals and portions as JSON. Device settings and the BLS catalog are not included.
backup.privacy: This file is unencrypted and contains personal nutrition data. Keep it in a safe place.
backup.summary: Contains {profiles} profiles, {foods} foods, {recipes} recipes and {meals} meals.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces the entire local data set; it does not merge data. A safety backup is automatically saved on this device first. Any sync connection is detached; reconnecting requires a fresh reconciliation.
backup.legacyWarning: This older backup has no global identities. New UUIDs will be generated; local IDs and stored values are preserved.
backup.confirm: I want to replace the local data set with this backup.
backup.exportMigration: Export backup from before database upgrade
backup.restored: The backup was restored. The previous data set is available in the safety backup.
backup.actionError: The action could not be completed. Check storage space and file access. If a restore was already committed, use the safety backup.
